steps.en: Put a model API key, passwords and your database URLs in .env, then start the stack
steps.zh: 在 .env 填模型 API key、各项密码和数据库连接串，启动整套服务

steps.en: Reads tables, columns, keys and query history from each source and embeds them
steps.zh: 从每个数据源读出表、列、键和查询历史，并做向量索引

steps.en: Turn on Semantic Compilation in Settings
steps.zh: 在 Settings 里打开 Semantic Compilation

steps.en: Samples each table, names business terms and keeps only joins the data confirms
steps.zh: 抽样每张表，命名业务术语，只保留数据能证实的连接关系

steps.en: Ask a business question in Chat, or from your agent over MCP
steps.zh: 在 Chat 里问业务问题，或让你的 agent 通过 MCP 来问

steps.en: Resolves terms, follows the joins, checks names against the catalog and runs the SQL
steps.zh: 把问题落到术语和连接路径上，按目录核对表名列名后执行 SQL

value.en: You stop hand-writing schema notes into prompts: answers come back with the SQL and the steps, so you can check the number against the source
value.zh: 不用再把表结构说明手抄进提示词：每个回答都带 SQL 和步骤，数字能对回源表核查
